batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2018-2019, Set-C — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.71-73 (questions), with the printed answer table alone at the head of p.74 and printed worked solutions on pp.74-75. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The book prints no per-subject headings in this paper (only a 'Short Syllabus' banner on p.71 and an 'Extra Syllabus' box on p.73); subject blocks by printed layout position, in printed order: Bangla Q1-3, English Q4-6, ICT Q7-8, General Knowledge Q9-14, Higher Mathematics Q15-17, 19-23, 26, 28-29, 31-34, 36 (with Q18, 24, 25, 27, 30 under the 'Extra Syllabus' box and Q35 in the right column of p.73), Physics Q37-41, 43-54 (with Q42, 55-58 in the right column of p.73), Chemistry Q59-65, 68-72, 74, 76-79 (with Q66, 67, 73, 75, 80 in the right column of p.73) — counts Bangla 3, English 3, ICT 2, General Knowledge 6, Physics 22, Chemistry 22, Higher Mathematics 22. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.71 carries Q1-17, 19-23, 26, 28, 29; p.72 carries Q31-34, 36-54, 59-65, 68, 69; p.73 carries Q70-72, 74, 76-79, the Extra-Syllabus Q18, 24, 25, 27, 30, and Q35, 42, 55-58, 66, 67, 73, 75, 80. The answer table prints exactly one dash, at Q38, and the printed worked solution (book PDF p.75) explicitly states '(সঠিক উত্তর নেই)' and computes the scalar product as 5, which is not among the printed options — so Q38 carries answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds []; its answerVerificationStatus is 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim, not cross-source verification — while its contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. No dual keys occur in this paper. One table/solution disagreement is flagged, at Q26: the answer table keys (c) and the printed solution is headed 'সমাধান: (c)', but the same printed solution's concluding line states 'সঠিক উত্তর: (d) কোনোটিই নয়'; the table key (c) is recorded and the disagreement is documented in Q26's extractionNote, not resolved. All other printed worked solutions (Short Syllabus: Q15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 26, 28, 29, 31, 32, 33, 34, 36, 39, 41, 43, 48, 49, 50, 51, 52, 53, 68, 69, 70; Extra Syllabus: Q18, 24, 25, 27, 30, 35, 42, 55, 56, 57, 58, 67, 75) agree with the answer table. Preserved print anomalies: Q14(c) prints 'PM' with a subscript 's'; Q26 is a projectile-motion item printed inside the Higher Mathematics run and Q53 is a Boolean-function item printed inside the Physics run (subjects follow printed block position); Q43's stem prints '60 kg কেজি'; the stems of Q44, Q46, Q47 and Q55 end with a printed hyphen; Q50(a) prints the exponent 10^19 without a minus sign; Q53's stem prints no question mark after 'কোনটি'. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-C of JU A Unit 2018-2019 occupies book PDF pp.71-75 (printed book pp.70-74): questions pp.71-73, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') alone at the head of p.74, printed worked solutions pp.74-75. Paper header (book PDF p.71) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৮-১৯ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট: A, সেট: C, সময়: ৫৫ মিনিট. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page, with zoomed re-reads for the Q3 sandhi options, the Q14(c) subscript, the Q27 option intervals and the Q26 worked solution. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, determinants wrapped in |...| with rows separated by ';', permutation/combination as ^nP_r / ^nC_r, unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; chemical formulas written with plain digits for subscripts, e.g. N2O5, HSO4^-).
